children: US industrial equipment maker's Q3 net sales increased and net income more than doubled yr/yr
Company attributes growth to higher domestic industrial equipment demand and strong European dairy markets
Backlog remains strong at $245.6 mln, with majority in industrial equipment
Company did not provide specific guidance for future revenue or earnings in its press release
DOMESTIC INDUSTRIAL EQUIPMENT - Co said revenue growth was primarily driven by increased demand in the US industrial equipment segment
EUROPEAN DAIRY MARKETS - Co said strong demand in European dairy farm markets led to increased backlog and revenue at Dutch subsidiary
MODULE FABRICATION CAPACITY - Co said transition into new module fabrication building added critical capacity to achieve domestic revenue growth
